description: This file declares wrapper classes for Metal's MTLTexture and MTLBuffer, including resource management, creation, and synchronization methods for Metal graphics resources within the ANGLE project.

classes.name: Resource
classes.description: Base class for Metal resources, managing GPU usage state and synchronization flags.

classes.name: Texture
classes.description: Wrapper class for Metal textures, supporting creation, data replacement, and view creation.

classes.name: Buffer
classes.description: Wrapper class for Metal buffers, supporting creation, resizing, and memory mapping.

methods.name: Make2DTexture
methods.description: Creates a 2D Metal texture with specified format, size, and options.

methods.name: MakeCubeTexture
methods.description: Creates a cube Metal texture with specified format, size, and options.

methods.name: MakeFromMetal
methods.description: Creates a Texture wrapper from an existing Metal texture object.

methods.name: MakeBuffer
methods.description: Creates a Metal buffer with specified size and initial data.
